# The Conversation

> Expert-written news and analysis by researchers and academics helping readers understand current events, science, policy, and society across multiple editions and topics.

The Conversation is a global platform featuring in-depth analysis and research-based journalism from leading academics and researchers. It operates multiple regional editions (U.S., Australia, Canada, Africa) and covers topics ranging from politics and health to environment and technology, all written by subject matter experts.

## Key Topics

- expert analysis
- academic journalism
- geopolitics
- current events
- academic research
- science and technology
- environmental health
- economic policy
- social justice
- housing policy
- energy policy
- water resources
- air pollution
- expert commentary
- research-based news

## Core Topics

- [Politics + Society](https://theconversation.com/us/politics): Political analysis by scholars on elections, Congress, and government policy
- [Science + Technology](https://theconversation.com/us/technology): Science and technology news covering AI, space, research, and innovation
- [Health + Medicine](https://theconversation.com/us/health): Health and medical news by doctors and researchers on treatments and public health
- [Environment + Energy](https://theconversation.com/us/environment): Environmental news on climate change, energy, biodiversity, and sustainability
- [Economy + Business](https://theconversation.com/us/business): Business and economics news by economists covering policy, industry, and markets
- [Education](https://theconversation.com/us/education): Education coverage explaining K-12, higher ed, and research in learning

## Content & Culture

- [Arts + Culture](https://theconversation.com/us/arts): Arts and culture section featuring expert commentary on film, music, and media
- [Ethics + Religion](https://theconversation.com/us/ethics): Religion and ethics coverage exploring beliefs, social justice, and observances
- [World](https://theconversation.com/us/world): International news and geopolitical analysis by expert researchers

## Regional Editions

- [The Conversation U.S.](https://theconversation.com/us): Main U.S. hub aggregating expert-written news across all topic areas
- [The Conversation Australia](https://theconversation.com/au): Australian edition featuring local politics, policy, and research analysis
- [The Conversation Canada](https://theconversation.com/ca): Canadian edition with academic research and commentary on national issues
- [La Conversation (Canada)](https://theconversation.com/ca-fr): French-Canadian edition of The Conversation with research-based analysis
- [The Conversation Africa](https://theconversation.com/africa): African affairs coverage with academic research and expert commentary

## Audio & Local

- [Podcasts](https://theconversation.com/us/podcasts): Audio content featuring expert commentary and research from The Conversation Weekly
- [Local News](https://theconversation.com/us/local): Local and regional news with expert analysis on community issues
